checks_by_claim.source_location: PDF p.41 (6.2), p.42 differences, p.43 Lemma 6.5 and pp.44–45 divisibility-two induction
checks_by_claim.verification: The effective isotropic half-fibre f is primitive because s.f=1. The theta/eta ratio has q0 coefficient 1, so the printed small fKM is 1. For v=(r,f,n), gcd(r,1,2n)=1, so dt=DT=8[eta^-12]_(q^((-r^2-2rn)/2)) and every corrected dt-hat vanishes. The PT expansion has r=0 sector zero; for r>=1,n>=0 the support bound r^2+2rn<=1 leaves only r=1,n=0, contributing 8. Thus fPT=fGW=8 and the printed difference lemma has left side 7 and right side 0 on an actual allowed geometric class.
checks_by_claim.impact: The necessary bridge from GW differences to the divisibility-two DT recurrence is false, so Major is supported. This is not a counterexample to the intended enumerative formula.
checks_by_claim.repair: Insert the missing factor 8 consistently. The independent r=2u substitution also needs 2u; the repaired two equations have determinant 1/4 and still force vanishing. The odd-n sum needs (1-p^2)^2. These supplementary coefficient corrections are not separate Major findings.

checks_by_claim.source_location: PDF pp.8–9 Definition 2.3 and Lemma 2.6; pp.24,29,42 actual use; Appendix A pp.50–52
checks_by_claim.verification: Theta_E8 has weight 4 and index Q/2. Its index-raising transform B=8Theta(2x,2tau)+(Theta(x,tau/2)+Theta(x,(tau+1)/2))/2 has q0=9, weight 4 and index Q. The numerator E4 B-9Theta^2 has zero entire q0 coefficient, so division by Delta gives a holomorphic full-level weak Jacobi form F of weight -4 and index Q. Full level has one cusp. For alpha0 of norm 4, the q1 zeta^-alpha0 coefficient of B is 1 while that of Theta^2 is 0; hence F has q0 zeta^-alpha0 coefficient 1. The printed operator q^2 zeta^alpha0 F(x+alpha0 tau,2tau) has q^-2 zeta^0 coefficient 1. Output charge zero forces that unique input charge, so cancellation is impossible. The input satisfies all stated lemma hypotheses.
checks_by_claim.impact: The false weak-space preservation is actually used in Corollary 4.7, Theorem 4.3 and Proposition 6.3. This is an essential proof input and remains Major.
checks_by_claim.counterexample_scope: This abstract weak Jacobi form is not asserted to be an actual GW potential, so it does not refute the geometric theorem itself.
checks_by_claim.repair_limit: The stronger n>=||alpha||^2/(4m) condition for every completion coefficient suffices at both cusps. The complete geometric support theorem for all iterated anomaly, relative and rubber coefficients remains unverified; no completed repair is claimed.

checks_by_claim.source_location: PDF p.47 (7.1) and bottom exponential; p.48 exponential and Theorem 7.2
checks_by_claim.verification: The (-1)^ell/ell! in (7.1) requires a negative exponential. For v=(1,0,0), sufficiently large even n gives N=1+n^2H^2/2 positive and odd. The four Enriques sections and two torsion line bundles give eight rigid sheaves, with H1(OY)=H0(omegaY)=0; Serre vanishing gives the pair space eight copies of P^(N-1). Its virtual count is 8(-1)^(N-1)N=8N. Rank one excludes fractional-rank decompositions; the printed positive exponential gives -8N.
checks_by_claim.impact: An actual nonzero pair invariant contradicts the necessary bridge to the VW formula, supporting Major despite a local sign repair.
checks_by_claim.repair_limit: Both exponents should be negative. Taking the formal fourth root gives VW=DT/4 and the primitive local value 2. General virtual degeneration is retained as an external dependency, not independently re-proved.

checks_by_claim.verification: The v>=0 formula literally truncates Delta^-1, but Appendix A.3 already supplies the full coset operator. Section 6 inputs have no principal part and Section 7 cites the full appendix operator. No necessary calculation is shown invalidated. The literal mismatch remains documented, but is no longer counted as Minor.

For m=5 and A=[[3,1],[50,17]], determinant is 1 and A lies in Gamma0(50), but conjugating by [[1,1/5],[0,1]] gives [[13,9/5],[50,7]], which is not integral. The proof actually uses this false subgroup inclusion. Replacing it by Gamma(2m^2) makes every conjugate entry integral with even lower-left entry and supports the completion comparison. The lemma's conclusion is not refuted.

The definition permits beta=0,g=0,n=3 with insertions (1,1,point). The constant-map space is Y with zero obstruction and integral 1. The unqualified genus-zero vanishing is false at this admitted boundary; forgetting to the unmarked degree-zero space cannot justify it. Source p.21 retains constant maps. Restricting to nonzero beta repairs the stated scope without refuting the ancestor/anomaly comparison.

With F2=G2-2G2(2tau), the correct expression is G2+F2. The incorrect F2/24 rewrite disagrees in the constant and q coefficients, but the preceding expression and used G2 derivative are already correct. No necessary computation is shown invalidated; retain normalisation clarification, not Minor.
